note: Columbia County (AR) has no queryable zoning district service. ArcGIS searches for Columbia County and Zoning returned nothing for the county. The state GIS office (gis.arkansas.gov) Planning_Cadastre has only parcels and PLSS/boundary layers, no zoning. Magnolia (county seat) posts its zoning map (dated 2020) and code as documents on its planning commission page, with no REST service found. Taylor publishes its zoning ordinance as a PDF with no GIS layer. Emerson shows no zoning service. The county's parcel viewer and commercial sites carry no zoning layer.
